Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XI OF 2000
BALOCHISTAN LOCAL
GOVERNMENT ELECTIONS
(SECOND AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE XI OF 2000
An Ordinance
further to amend the Balochistan Local Government Election Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 19th December, 2000]
No. Legis.-1-122(Law)/2000,
dated 19-12-2000.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 18th December, 2000, is hereby published for general
information:--
1. Short title and
commencement. ---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Balochistan Local
Government Elections (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2000.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

2. In the Balochistan
Local Government Elections Ordinance, 2000, hereinafter referred to as the said
Ordinance, after section 18, the following new section shall be added,
namely:--
"18-A. Casual
Vacancy.--(1) If the seat of a member becomes vacant during the term of
office of a council, a new member shall be elected through bye-election and
such member shall hold office for the remaining part of such term:
Provided that all bye-elections
shall be held once a year on the dates fixed by the Chief Election
Commissioner.
(2) The vacancy in the office of
Nazim shall be filled by officiating Nazim elected by the members of the
council concerned by a majority votes; provided that:
(a) the member
so elected shall continue to hold his substantive office as member till the
bye-election to fill the vacant office is held;
(b) the
Naib-Nazim will not be eligible for bye-election or to be officiating Nazim;
(c) in the event
of temporary absence of the Nazim, the Naib Nazim of the council concerned
shall deputize in place of the Nazim."
